en:
Hey, you got a minute?
I got something to talk about.
Ah, okay...

<CLT=cltMIND>He seems upset...
Did I do something to make him angry?

I'm just gonna say it!
What are you moping around for!?
What?

When my sidekick is moping, 
it really ticks me off!
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm...moping?

I told you, man! Don't hesitate to 
talk to me if something's wrong.

But you're still keeping stuff from me! 
Am I not reliable enough!?

Spit it out! If you bottle everything up, 
it can't get fixed!

I'm sorry, I don't know what you're
talking about. I'm not looking for advice...
You've got some guts trying to lie to me.

Fine then!
Listen up...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito encouraged me, complimenting me
about my talent. I should tell him...
<CLT=cltMIND>Then he'd understand why.

<CLT=cltMIND>I told him all about the case that
got me the title of <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>I told him everything...so that he
would know how untalented I really am.

I see... So you were chosen after 
you solved a case.
Yes, and the most important part...

I just happened to find some evidence that
was missed. I accidentally solved the puzzle.

It was all coincidence, happenstance...
And I foiled the culprit's plan for vengeance.

I didn't understand the situation, I didn't
know any better. That man...hates me.

Geez... You worry about the 
most trivial stuff, man.
What do you mean, trivial?
Well, being a detective is a trivial job...
You have no right to say that!
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltMIND>...Trivial?
What do you mean, trivial?

The culprit's feelings. Why are you 
even worrying about them?
What...?

You're right. Being a detective
is a trivial job...

You dig up dirty secrets for money.
That's the whole job.

Huh? What are you talking about?
Where's your pride in your work?

Your job isn't trivial! It's great!
I'm talking about the culprit!

You have no right to say that!
You don't know what I've been through!

Hah! Nice! It's good to see you 
actually have some bite to you.

You're right. I don't know.
After all, I'm not you.
And that's why I can say this to you!

The culprit was trying to get away 
with it by using a trick, right?

He killed someone and was trying to 
get away with it! He's a bad guy!

If he'd gotten away with it, he'd be 
crushed by the weight of his guilt.

But you got him before that happened! 
He should be thanking you!

Don't worry, even if that idiot holds 
a grudge against you...

I'll support you all the way!
I know you did the right thing!
And not just with that guy!

From now on, if anyone holds a grudge 
against you...I'll kick their ass!

So you just gotta follow the 
path you believe in!

You're my sidekick. So don't hold back 
and rely on me whenever you need to!
Kaito...thank you.

<CLT=cltMIND>Alright, so he's foolhardy. But he supports
me and expects nothing in return...

<CLT=cltMIND>He does so much for me...
I could never turn my back on that.

<CLT=cltMIND>I will never betray his support and trust.
I will never break my bond with Kaito!

...I understand, Kaito.
I will always depend on you.
Yeah! Just leave it to me!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito's smile was as bright as starlight.
I couldn't help but smile back.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Everything is going to be okay. As long
as we have this, we can move forward.

<CLT=cltMIND>Sometimes I feel as though I'm dragging
him down, but I know I'll catch up one day.

<CLT=cltMIND>I bet he'd laugh and tell me I
have a lot of nerve for a sidekick.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Kaito's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You have learned a new skill, <CLT=cltSTRONG>Spacewalk<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito and I went our separate ways,
and I returned to my room.
